fixed_scopes.state_warm_rule: Replay raw byte zero through each scope end; report only coordinates bound inside the raw half-open measurement interval.

physical_g_source: At field entry, replay the frozen Endpoint428 HORIZON-A oldest-surviving 2^24-slot exact-16-byte-context clock using polynomial base 0x9e3779b185ebca87 and age strictly greater than 100000000 WRT bytes. A repeated source tape binds target and source coordinates, exact context hash, transition-state witness, and a donor reconstructed only from decoded WRT bytes. Without that exact repeat binding, G is inadmissible rather than a zero result.
decision_scope: Only full-arm mixture gain, canonical-raw chronological thirds computed as min(2,floor(3*(raw_before-raw_begin)/(raw_end-raw_begin))), control margins, repeat identity, causal closure, and resources decide the shadow. Route/top-emitting-mode/drift/support/positive-opportunity reports are descriptive and cannot select or rescue v1; silent deletion is closure mass, not a persistent emitting-mode label.
